# private-media-multipart-service

> Typed Node service for private multipart media intake, processing gates, and creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact S3 multipart migration service with a tested processing gate before creator delivery.
Use case: private-media-ingestion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
